source.description: Fixed Double Ratchet KDF and cipher vectors from libsignal v0.99.1. The chain-key vector is the Rust unit test test_chain_key_derivation in rust/protocol/src/ratchet/keys.rs: message keys are derived with no SPQR salt (generate_keys(None)), i.e. HKDF-SHA256 with absent salt. Upstream asserts only cipher_key, mac_key, next_chain_key and the indices; the spec agent recomputed all of them with OpenSSL (HMAC-SHA256 with one-byte data 0x01/0x02, then HKDF-SHA256 info 'WhisperMessageKeys', 80 bytes) and they matched. The message-key seed and the IV were not asserted upstream; they come from that OpenSSL recomputation and are marked derived. The AES-256-CBC vector is the Rust unit test aes_cbc_test in rust/crypto/src/aes_cbc.rs (the cipher used for 1:1 and sender-key messages); the spec agent re-checked the ciphertext with OpenSSL. No upstream test fixes a root-key (WhisperRatchet) step or a SignalMessage MAC.

vectors.name: aes_cbc.rs aes_cbc_test: decrypting the recovered plaintext (10 bytes, not a multiple of 16) must fail
aes_cbc.rs aes_cbc_test: decrypting the ciphertext with the ciphertext itself as IV yields invalid padding and must fail
aes_cbc.rs aes_cbc_test: flipping the IV's top bit flips the first plaintext byte
